content.short: Singularity provides onboarding and on-ramp solutions for wallets and dApps.
content.description: New projects expanding to new chains often find it difficult to secure support from fiat onramp providers or bridge services that enable onboarding into their ecosystems. Singularity tackles this challenge by transforming multi-hop, multi-chain transactions into a single, one-click experience. By simplifying cross-chain operations and fiat onramp flows, it reduces onboarding friction, streamlines user journeys, and makes token and NFT purchases noticeably easier, delivering improvements of over 30%.
